lead_raw_text:
The structure of LuCu (Lu8Cu8 per cell) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Cu and Lu centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per atom: Cu is surrounded by 8 Cu and 4 Lu, while Lu has 12 Cu neighbors, all at 2.7758 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Cu-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Cu- and Lu-centered polyhedra.
